chunks: 1729 - And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
"Goodness and charity eliminate poverty, increase lifespan, and repel from their possessor seventy evil deaths."

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charitable giving for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: How do goodness and charity affect poverty, lifespan, and protection from misfortune in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue and benefit of righteousness and charity in both worldly and personal life. It presents charity as a means of removing poverty, increasing one's lifespan, and protecting a person from harmful and ill-fated forms of death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1729 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Goodness and charity eliminate poverty, increase lifespan, and protect their giver from seventy types of ill-fated deaths."
